🎤✨ Show: The Next Headliner

Five young performers are given the chance to compete for a major break in the music industry. They arrive with big dreams and different personalities, but the pressure to stand out quickly creates tension as they struggle to balance competition with the friendships forming between them.

As the girls spend more time together, they begin to see beyond the competition. They encourage each other through difficult performances, deal with self-doubt, and learn that their differences can actually make them stronger as a group.

What starts as five individuals fighting for their own chance at stardom eventually becomes the beginning of a band. With their friendship at the center, they decide to combine their talents and pursue their musical dreams together.

The cast includes Olivia Taylor Cohen, Kate Mina Lin, Journey Montana, Indi Star, and Giselle Torres.
